market.category: Caffeine trackers and sleep planning tools
market.audience: Coffee, tea, pre-workout, and energy drink users who want to understand timing before another dose
market.problem: A basic caffeine log records the decision after it happens and leaves the user to translate intake into a bedtime impact
market.advantage: Caffeine Tracker previews a proposed dose and time against a personal bedtime forecast before anything is logged
market.competitive_context: The category commonly offers drink logs and caffeine decay charts. This app centers the pre-log decision, dose-specific timing, and visible uncertainty range

proof_points.claim: The Now screen shows current and bedtime estimates with a visible half-life range
The Planner compares the current bedtime forecast with a proposed dose before logging
The Timeline shows caffeine intake and modeled bedtime values over time

story.throughline: Understand tonight, preview the next dose, then see the pattern over time

frames.header: Know what may remain at bedtime

pitch.benefit: See a bedtime estimate without translating a day of drinks by hand
pitch.problem: An intake total alone does not answer what may remain tonight
pitch.advantage: The Now screen keeps current and bedtime estimates together with a visible uncertainty range
pitch.proof: The literal Now screen shows estimated caffeine now, at bedtime, and a 4 to 6 hour range

pitch.problem: Most caffeine logs reveal the impact only after the entry exists

pitch.proof: The literal Planner compares the bedtime estimate without and with the proposed drink
